column1: # RSpace datum-first retained-automaton × authoritative Bag candidate selection.
# Production implementation: 61accc170. The Bag remains PathMap<Multiplicity>; the retained transition authority remains PathMap<TerminalId>.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned; performance governor; boost enabled.
# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -p rspace_plus_plus --bench rspace_retained_bag_product

# Fixture: one deliberately last matching resting datum, one unrelated fresh datum, canonical control order, and exact result equivalence before timing. Diverse and long-shared-prefix candidate corpora use 16, 256, and 4,096 retained continuations.

# Criterion: one shot per experiment; 82 post-warm-up samples per arm/cell; 2 s warm-up; 5 s requested measurement interval; 99% confidence; 1% significance; no competing Cargo or rustc process at preflight.

# Experiment 224: REJECTED. Bytewise synchronized zippers won at large cardinality but shared/256 regressed 2.104x. Pgmcp digests: control sha256:572593b1f91fd37329196f1284e37ab8c69d478c3572f129be38e26308c0a86d; treatment sha256:df10cab03df38ca5f8544825fc83e86b24877212306cef4def38adfafbbe3668.

# Experiment 225: REJECTED. Compressed unary descent reduced the rejected shared/256 treatment by 43.6% but remained 14.5% slower than its contemporaneous control. Pgmcp digests include seven metrics because one non-decisional duplicated historical metric was retained transparently: control sha256:313fbfae5535f06ef6a2c7039009d29f25c902e6cbd2232e39789fec5779dedc; treatment sha256:06d4c2562a04983be4ec274006c46a138ca15767e18eb81328b4b89a5fd5fb31.
